name: Shakti meditation prep: hippocampus right
origin: Todd Murphy, 8 Coil Shakti meditation recipe
summary: Murphy's meditation recipe for the 8 Coil Shakti, hippocampal variant: 30 min of the hippocampal signal over the right temporal lobe only, then meditate an hour or two later. Murphy reports deeper meditation when the practice follows the session ('Shakti first, and the other an hour to 90 minutes later'). The vendor's file is not published; the signal is rebuilt from published descriptions.
setting: No sensory deprivation needed; sit or lie relaxed. Do not meditate during the session. Practise (for example Vipassana or Zen) 60 to 120 min after it ends.
schedule: Murphy asks for patience: it may take several sessions. Vendor rules: at most once a week or every 72 h, never on consecutive days; a series of up to 6 sessions, then a 21-day break.
notes: The vendor lists 'the hippocampal signals over only the right side' among its sessions for meditation (shakti_meditation.htm, Do's and Don'ts) and writes: '30 minutes is also the right length for meditation enhancement. Do your session, and then begin meditation about an hour or two after the end of the session' (during_sessions.htm, 'Shorter sessions'). This program plays 30 min on four coils over the right temporal lobe (front FT8, top C6, back TP8, bottom T10); the left channels stay silent. The sites and the use of four coils are this project's choices. The vendor has a standard and an alternative hippocampal signal; the standard one is used here. The stand-in is the primed burst: one pulse, then four pulses 170 ms later, three times in 0.74 s (after Tsang 2004 p.5 [1017]), then 4 s of silence. It is rebuilt from descriptions: the vendor's file is not published. The wait and the meditation are not part of the program; use your own timer. Murphy's other sessions for meditation are separate programs, such as murphy-shakti8-feelgood-1phase-frontal and murphy-shakti8-altered-states-40min. Field strength: the vendor gives 10 to 20 mG without saying where it is measured (mono_proposal.htm, 'Formal Discussion'). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT there, the field is about 24 uT at the scalp. The support is Murphy's own report. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Murphy warns that meditating or using another mind machine during the session 'gives your brain conflicting instructions'. Headache or pressure with hippocampal signals (vendor: about 2%): lower the intensity by one third. Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop at once on fear or any distress.
